exercises.name: Bodyweight squat
cues: Feet shoulder-width, toes slightly out.
Sit between your heels, chest up, then stand tall.

exercises.name: Box squat
cues: Sit back until you lightly touch the box.
Drive up without rocking off it.

exercises.name: Goblet squat
cues: Hold the weight at your chest, elbows down.
Elbows track inside the knees at the bottom.

exercises.name: Back squat
cues: Bar on your upper back, brace before you descend.
Knees track over toes; stand up as one piece.
mistakes: Hips shooting up before the chest.

exercises.name: Front squat
cues: Bar on the front of your shoulders, elbows high.
Stay upright and drive the elbows up out of the hole.
mistakes: Elbows dropping so the bar rolls forward.

exercises.name: Pause back squat
cues: Hold two seconds at the bottom, staying tight.
Drive up hard from the pause.
mistakes: Relaxing in the hole during the pause.

exercises.name: Safety bar squat
cues: Hold the handles and keep your chest proud.
Push your upper back into the pads as you stand.
mistakes: Getting folded forward by the bar.

exercises.name: Zercher squat
cues: Cradle the bar in your elbow crease.
Stay upright and squeeze the bar into you.

exercises.name: Heels-elevated goblet squat
cues: Heels on a small plate or wedge.
Sink straight down, knees well forward.

exercises.name: Leg press
cues: Feet mid-platform, lower until hips start to curl.
Press through the whole foot; don't lock knees hard.
mistakes: Lower back peeling off the pad.

exercises.name: Hack squat
cues: Shoulders under the pads, feet shoulder-width.
Control down, drive up through mid-foot.
mistakes: Cutting depth as the weight climbs.

exercises.name: Belt squat
cues: Belt at the hips, hands light on the rails.
Squat straight down and stand tall.
mistakes: Pulling yourself up with the rails.

exercises.name: Wall sit
cues: Back flat on the wall, thighs parallel to the floor.
Breathe and hold.

exercises.name: Pistol squat
cues: Reach the free leg and arms forward.
Sit down slowly on one leg and stand without twisting.

exercises.name: Skater squat
cues: Back knee lowers behind you toward the floor.
Lean slightly forward and drive up through the front foot.

exercises.name: Cossack squat
cues: Wide stance, shift onto one leg and sit deep.
Keep the straight leg's toes pointing up.
mistakes: Heel of the working foot lifting.

exercises.name: Landmine squat
cues: Hold the bar end at your chest.
Sit down and stand up, leaning into the bar.
mistakes: Letting the bar pull you forward.

exercises.name: Sissy squat
cues: Rise onto your toes and lean back as the knees travel forward.
Keep hips and torso in a straight line.
mistakes: Bending at the hips instead of the knees.

exercises.name: Trap bar jump
cues: Light load; dip quickly and jump.
Land softly and reset each rep.
mistakes: Going too heavy so the jump turns into a shrug.

exercises.name: Deadlift
cues: Bar over mid-foot, pull the slack out before you lift.
Push the floor away and stand tall.
mistakes: Rounding the lower back off the floor.

exercises.name: Sumo deadlift
cues: Wide stance, toes out, grip inside the knees.
Spread the floor and push hips to the bar.
mistakes: Hips rising first and turning it into a stiff-leg pull.

exercises.name: Trap bar deadlift
cues: Stand in the middle, grip the handles.
Chest up, push through the floor and stand tall.
mistakes: Squatting it with the hips too low and the chest dropping.

exercises.name: Deficit deadlift
cues: Stand on a low plate; same setup as a deadlift.
Stay tight through the longer pull.
mistakes: Losing the back position from the deeper start.

exercises.name: Romanian deadlift
cues: Soft knees, push your hips back until you feel the hamstrings.
Keep the bar close and stand up by squeezing the glutes.
mistakes: Reaching for the floor with a rounded back.

exercises.name: Dumbbell Romanian deadlift
cues: Dumbbells slide down the front of your thighs.
Hips back, flat back, then stand tall.
mistakes: Bending the knees so it turns into a squat.

exercises.name: Single-leg Romanian deadlift
cues: Hinge on one leg, back leg reaching behind you.
Keep the hips square to the floor.
mistakes: Hip of the free leg opening toward the ceiling.

exercises.name: Stiff-leg deadlift
cues: Knees nearly straight, lower the bar from the floor.
Long spine throughout.
mistakes: Jerking the bar off the floor.

exercises.name: Good morning
cues: Bar on your back, soft knees, push hips back.
Stop when your torso nears parallel, then stand.

exercises.name: Kettlebell deadlift
cues: Bell between your feet, hips back, flat back.
Stand up by pushing the floor away.

exercises.name: Kettlebell swing
cues: Hike the bell back, then snap the hips forward.
Arms are ropes; the hips float the bell to chest height.
mistakes: Lifting the bell with the arms.

exercises.name: Single-arm kettlebell swing
cues: Same snap as a two-hand swing.
Resist the rotation through your trunk.
mistakes: Letting the shoulder get yanked forward.

exercises.name: Hip thrust
cues: Upper back on the bench, bar over the hips.
Tuck your chin, drive up and squeeze at the top.
mistakes: Arching the lower back instead of using the glutes.

exercises.name: Glute bridge
cues: Lie on your back, feet flat, knees bent.
Push through the heels and lift the hips.

exercises.name: Single-leg glute bridge
cues: One foot down, the other knee to your chest.
Lift without letting the hips tilt.
mistakes: Hips dropping on the free side.

exercises.name: Single-leg hip thrust
cues: Upper back on the bench, one foot down.
Drive up and keep the hips level.

exercises.name: Back extension
cues: Hips on the pad, hinge down with a long spine.
Rise until your body is in a line.

exercises.name: Reverse hyper
cues: Torso on the pad, legs hanging.
Swing the legs up with the glutes, control down.
mistakes: Using momentum to fling the legs.

exercises.name: Nordic hamstring curl
cues: Kneel with ankles anchored.
Lower as slowly as you can, catch yourself, push back up.
mistakes: Bending at the hips to cheat the descent.

exercises.name: Hamstring slider curl
cues: Bridge up with heels on sliders or towels.
Slide out slowly and curl back in, hips high.
mistakes: Hips sagging as the legs straighten.

exercises.name: Cable pull-through
cues: Rope between your legs, walk out and hinge.
Snap the hips forward to stand.

exercises.name: Rack pull
cues: Bar set just below the knees.
Brace, pull and lock out with the glutes.

exercises.name: Split squat
cues: Staggered stance, drop the back knee straight down.
Front foot flat; drive up through it.

exercises.name: Bulgarian split squat
cues: Back foot on a bench, front foot far enough out to sink.
Lower under control, drive up through the front foot.

exercises.name: Reverse lunge
cues: Step back and lower the back knee.
Push through the front foot to return.

exercises.name: Forward lunge
cues: Step forward, drop the back knee.
Push back to the start in one motion.
mistakes: Short steps that push the knee far past the toes.

exercises.name: Walking lunge
cues: Step into each lunge and keep walking.
Torso tall, back knee kisses the floor.
mistakes: Wobbling side to side on a narrow line.

exercises.name: Deficit reverse lunge
cues: Stand on a low step and lunge back off it.
Sink deep and drive back up.

exercises.name: Lateral lunge
cues: Step wide to one side and sit into that hip.
Keep the other leg straight, push back to center.
mistakes: Letting the knee drift past the toes sideways.

exercises.name: Curtsy lunge
cues: Step one leg behind and across.
Lower, then return to stand tall.

exercises.name: Step-up
cues: Whole foot on the box.
Drive up through that leg without pushing off the floor.

exercises.name: Lateral step-up
cues: Stand beside the box, step up sideways.
Control the way down.
mistakes: Knee caving as you step up.

exercises.name: Crossover step-up
cues: Cross the outside leg over onto the box.
Drive up tall and step back down under control.
mistakes: Leaning the torso over the box.

exercises.name: Front-foot-elevated split squat
cues: Front foot on a low step.
Sink deep and drive up through the front foot.

exercises.name: Sled push
cues: Hands high on the posts, body at a lean.
Short powerful steps, drive through the balls of the feet.
mistakes: Standing too upright and pushing with the arms.

exercises.name: Backward sled drag
cues: Hold the straps and walk backward.
Stay low and push through the toes.
mistakes: Leaning back and pulling with the arms.

exercises.name: Push-up
cues: Hands under shoulders, body in a straight line.
Lower your chest to a fist's height off the floor.

exercises.name: Incline push-up
cues: Hands on a bench or box.
Lower your chest to the edge, push back.

exercises.name: Wall push-up
cues: Hands on a wall at chest height.
Lean in and press back with a straight body.

exercises.name: Deficit push-up
cues: Hands on plates or handles.
Lower past your hands for a deeper stretch.

exercises.name: Plyometric push-up
cues: Lower fast and push hard enough for your hands to leave the floor.
Land soft with bent elbows.

exercises.name: Bench press
cues: Shoulder blades pinched, feet planted.
Lower to your lower chest, press back over the shoulders.
mistakes: Bouncing the bar off the chest.

exercises.name: Pause bench press
cues: Hold the bar still on your chest for a count.
Press without losing your setup.
mistakes: Sinking the bar into the chest during the pause.

exercises.name: Close-grip bench press
cues: Hands shoulder-width.
Elbows tucked, touch lower chest.
mistakes: Gripping so narrow the wrists bend.

exercises.name: Incline bench press
cues: Bench at about 30 degrees.
Lower to your upper chest.
mistakes: Bench set so steep it becomes a shoulder press.

exercises.name: Dumbbell bench press
cues: Dumbbells over your chest, palms forward or angled in.
Lower to chest level and press together.
mistakes: Dropping the dumbbells too low and losing tension.

exercises.name: Incline dumbbell press
cues: Bench at about 30 degrees.
Press up and slightly in.

exercises.name: Single-arm dumbbell bench press
cues: One dumbbell, other hand on your belly.
Stay square on the bench as you press.

exercises.name: Machine chest press
cues: Handles at mid-chest.
Press out and control back.
mistakes: Shoulders rolling forward at the end.

exercises.name: Cable chest fly
cues: Slight bend in the elbows, open wide.
Hug the handles together in front of your chest.
mistakes: Turning it into a press with bent arms.

exercises.name: Dumbbell fly
cues: Arms slightly bent, open until you feel a stretch.
Bring the dumbbells back over your chest.
mistakes: Going too heavy and too deep.

exercises.name: Dip
cues: Shoulders down, lower until upper arms are parallel.
Press back to straight arms.
mistakes: Shrugging the shoulders to the ears.

exercises.name: Bench dip
cues: Hands on a bench behind you.
Lower until elbows reach 90 degrees, press up.
mistakes: Dropping too deep and straining the shoulders.

exercises.name: Weighted dip
cues: Weight hangs from a belt.
Same depth as a bodyweight dip.

exercises.name: Landmine press
cues: Hold the bar end at your shoulder.
Press up and forward, reaching through.
mistakes: Leaning back to finish the rep.

exercises.name: Half-kneeling landmine press
cues: Kneel with the down knee on the pressing side.
Squeeze that glute and press up and forward.

exercises.name: Overhead press
cues: Bar on your front shoulders, glutes tight.
Press straight up and move your head through.

exercises.name: Push press
cues: Short dip with the knees, then drive.
Use the legs to start the bar, arms to finish.
mistakes: Dipping too deep and turning it into a squat.

exercises.name: Dumbbell shoulder press
cues: Dumbbells at your shoulders.
Press up until arms are straight.

exercises.name: Arnold press
cues: Start palms facing you.
Rotate the palms forward as you press.

exercises.name: Single-arm kettlebell press
cues: Bell in the rack, wrist straight.
Press up and stack it over your shoulder.

exercises.name: Pike push-up
cues: Hips high, head lowers between your hands.
Press back up.
mistakes: Head lowering in front of the hands.

exercises.name: Handstand push-up
cues: Kick up to a wall, hands just outside your shoulders.
Lower your head to the floor and press.

exercises.name: Machine shoulder press
cues: Handles at shoulder height.
Press up and control down.

exercises.name: Lateral raise
cues: Slight bend at the elbows.
Raise to shoulder height, lead with the elbows.

exercises.name: Front raise
cues: Raise to eye height with straight arms.
Lower under control.

exercises.name: Y raise
cues: Chest on an incline bench, thumbs up.
Raise your arms in a Y.

exercises.name: Bent-over row
cues: Hinge to about 45 degrees, flat back.
Row to your belly button.

exercises.name: Pendlay row
cues: Torso parallel to the floor, bar starts on the floor each rep.
Row explosively to the lower chest.
mistakes: Using the hips to swing the bar.

exercises.name: One-arm dumbbell row
cues: Knee and hand on a bench, flat back.
Pull the dumbbell to your hip.
mistakes: Twisting the torso to lift it.

exercises.name: Chest-supported row
cues: Chest on an incline bench.
Row the elbows back and squeeze.
mistakes: Lifting the chest off the pad.

exercises.name: Seated cable row
cues: Sit tall, slight knee bend.
Pull to your belly, shoulder blades together.

exercises.name: Inverted row
cues: Hang under a bar, body straight.
Pull your chest to the bar.

exercises.name: Machine row
cues: Chest on the pad.
Pull the handles to your ribs.

exercises.name: Face pull
cues: Rope at face height.
Pull to your forehead and spread the rope apart.
mistakes: Leaning back and rowing it to the chest.

exercises.name: Band pull-apart
cues: Arms straight in front, band at shoulder width.
Pull the band to your chest.
mistakes: Bending the elbows to make it easier.

exercises.name: Reverse fly
cues: Hinge forward, arms hanging.
Open your arms out to the sides.

exercises.name: Single-arm cable row
cues: Staggered stance, one handle.
Row and rotate slightly toward the pull.

exercises.name: Pull-up
cues: Overhand grip, start from a dead hang.
Pull your chest toward the bar.
mistakes: Kicking and swinging to the top.

exercises.name: Chin-up
cues: Underhand grip, shoulder-width.
Pull until your chin clears the bar.

exercises.name: Band-assisted pull-up
cues: Band looped on the bar, knee or foot in the band.
Pull your chest up, lower slowly.
mistakes: Bouncing out of the bottom on the band.

exercises.name: Negative pull-up
cues: Jump or step to the top.
Lower as slowly as you can.

exercises.name: Weighted pull-up
cues: Weight on a belt or between your feet.
Full hang to chest at the bar.
mistakes: Shortening the range as the weight climbs.

exercises.name: Lat pulldown
cues: Grip a little wider than your shoulders.
Pull to your upper chest, elbows down.
mistakes: Leaning way back and rowing it.

exercises.name: Single-arm lat pulldown
cues: Kneel or sit tall, one handle.
Pull your elbow down to your hip.

exercises.name: Straight-arm pulldown
cues: Arms straight, slight hinge.
Sweep the bar down to your thighs.
mistakes: Bending the elbows into a pushdown.

exercises.name: Scapular pull-up
cues: Dead hang with straight arms.
Pull your shoulders down away from your ears, then relax.

exercises.name: Dead hang
cues: Hang with straight arms.
Breathe and keep a firm grip.
mistakes: Shoulders fully relaxed up by the ears for long holds.

exercises.name: Towel hang
cues: Drape towels over the bar and grip them.
Hang with active shoulders.

exercises.name: Rope climb
cues: Lock the rope between your feet.
Stand up on the lock, reach, repeat.

exercises.name: Barbell curl
cues: Elbows pinned at your sides.
Curl up and lower slowly.

exercises.name: Dumbbell curl
cues: Palms forward, elbows still.
Curl up and lower under control.

exercises.name: Hammer curl
cues: Palms facing each other.
Curl without swinging.

exercises.name: Cable curl
cues: Stand tall, elbows at your sides.
Curl and squeeze at the top.

exercises.name: Triceps pushdown
cues: Elbows tucked at your sides.
Push down until your arms are straight.

exercises.name: Overhead triceps extension
cues: Weight behind your head, elbows up.
Straighten your arms toward the ceiling.

exercises.name: Skull crusher
cues: Lie back, arms over your shoulders.
Bend at the elbows to lower behind your head.
mistakes: Moving the upper arm with each rep.

exercises.name: Wrist curl
cues: Forearms on your thighs, palms up.
Curl the wrists up and lower slowly.

exercises.name: Reverse wrist curl
cues: Forearms on your thighs, palms down.
Lift the back of your hand, lower slowly.
mistakes: Going too heavy for the small muscles.

exercises.name: Wrist pronation and supination
cues: Hold a light dumbbell or hammer by one end.
Rotate the palm slowly down and up.

exercises.name: Rice bucket grip work
cues: Plunge your hand into a bucket of rice.
Open, close and twist the hand continuously.

exercises.name: Plate pinch
cues: Pinch two smooth plates together.
Hold or walk with them.
mistakes: Letting the plates rest on your leg.

exercises.name: Leg extension
cues: Pad on your shins, knees at the pivot.
Straighten and squeeze.

exercises.name: Lying leg curl
cues: Pad above your heels.
Curl up and lower slowly.

exercises.name: Seated leg curl
cues: Thigh pad locked down.
Curl under and control back.

exercises.name: Standing calf raise
cues: Balls of the feet on a step.
Rise all the way, lower to a full stretch.

exercises.name: Single-leg calf raise
cues: One foot on a step, hold support.
Full range up and down.

exercises.name: Seated calf raise
cues: Knees bent, weight on your thighs.
Rise high and lower slowly.

exercises.name: Tibialis raise
cues: Back against a wall, heels out in front.
Lift your toes as high as you can.

exercises.name: Copenhagen plank
cues: Side plank with the top leg on a bench.
Lift the hips and hold.

exercises.name: Hip adduction machine
cues: Pads on your inner knees.
Squeeze together and control out.

exercises.name: Hip abduction machine
cues: Pads on your outer knees.
Push out and control back.

exercises.name: Banded lateral walk
cues: Band above the knees or at the ankles, half squat.
Step sideways keeping tension.
mistakes: Standing up tall and losing tension.

exercises.name: Farmer's carry
cues: Heavy weight in each hand, stand tall.
Walk with short, steady steps.

exercises.name: Suitcase carry
cues: Weight in one hand only.
Walk without leaning toward it.
mistakes: Leaning away or toward the weight.

exercises.name: Overhead carry
cues: Weight locked out overhead, ribs down.
Walk with the arm stacked.

exercises.name: Front rack carry
cues: Bells in the rack, elbows in.
Walk tall and breathe.

exercises.name: Sandbag bear-hug carry
cues: Hug the bag high on your chest.
Walk with short steps.

exercises.name: Plank
cues: Elbows under shoulders, body in a line.
Squeeze glutes and brace.

exercises.name: Side plank
cues: Elbow under shoulder, hips stacked.
Lift the hips into a straight line.

exercises.name: Dead bug
cues: On your back, arms and knees up.
Lower opposite arm and leg while keeping your back down.
mistakes: Lower back peeling off the floor.

exercises.name: Bird dog
cues: On hands and knees.
Reach opposite arm and leg long without tipping.

exercises.name: Hollow hold
cues: Lower back pressed down, arms and legs long.
Hold the banana shape.

exercises.name: Ab wheel rollout
cues: Kneel, roll forward keeping ribs down.
Pull back with the abs.
mistakes: Lower back sagging at the far point.

exercises.name: Body saw
cues: Forearm plank with feet on sliders.
Rock forward and back from the shoulders.

exercises.name: Hanging knee raise
cues: Hang still, then lift your knees to your chest.
Lower slowly without swinging.

exercises.name: Hanging leg raise
cues: Straight legs, lift to hip height or higher.
Control the lowering.

exercises.name: Reverse crunch
cues: Knees bent, curl your hips off the floor.
Lower slowly.

exercises.name: Crunch
cues: Hands lightly at your temples.
Curl your ribs toward your hips.

exercises.name: Cable crunch
cues: Kneel, rope at your head.
Curl your ribs to your hips.
mistakes: Sitting back and pulling with the hips.

exercises.name: Pallof press
cues: Side-on to the anchor, hands at your chest.
Press straight out and resist the twist.
mistakes: Letting the hands drift toward the anchor.

exercises.name: Half-kneeling Pallof press
cues: Kneel with the inside knee down.
Press out, hold, return.

exercises.name: Suitcase deadlift
cues: Weight at your side.
Deadlift without tilting toward it.

exercises.name: Bear crawl
cues: Knees an inch off the floor.
Move opposite hand and foot together.

exercises.name: Bear plank
cues: Hands and toes, knees hovering.
Hold without rocking.

exercises.name: Stir the pot
cues: Forearms on a stability ball in a plank.
Draw small circles without moving the hips.
mistakes: Circles so big the hips sag.

exercises.name: L-sit
cues: Hands on parallettes or the floor, press down.
Lift straight legs in front.

exercises.name: Hip airplane
cues: Hinge on one leg like a single-leg RDL.
Rotate the hips open and closed.
mistakes: Turning the shoulders instead of the hips.

exercises.name: Box jump
cues: Swing your arms and jump onto the box.
Land softly in a quarter squat, then step down.
mistakes: Picking a box so high you land in a deep squat.

exercises.name: Squat jump
cues: Quick dip, then jump as high as you can.
Land quietly and reset.

exercises.name: Countermovement jump
cues: Arms swing back as you dip.
Explode up, reaching high.

exercises.name: Depth jump
cues: Step off a low box.
Touch down and jump straight back up as fast as you can.
mistakes: Sinking deep on landing so the bounce is lost.

exercises.name: Drop landing
cues: Step off a low box.
Stick the landing: knees out, hips back, quiet feet.

exercises.name: Broad jump
cues: Swing and jump forward as far as you can.
Stick the landing.

exercises.name: Consecutive broad jumps
cues: Land and immediately jump again.
Keep the contacts short.

exercises.name: Lateral bound
cues: Push off one leg sideways.
Land on the other leg and hold the landing.

exercises.name: Continuous lateral bounds
cues: Bound side to side without pausing.
Push off the outside edge of the foot.

exercises.name: Lateral hop
cues: Two feet, hop side to side over a line.
Quick, light contacts.

exercises.name: Single-leg hop
cues: Hop forward on one leg.
Stick each landing for a second.

exercises.name: Pogo hop
cues: Straight legs, bounce on the balls of your feet.
Short, springy contacts.

exercises.name: Single-leg pogo
cues: Bounce on one foot, knee nearly straight.
Stay tall and quick.

exercises.name: Tuck jump
cues: Jump and pull your knees to your chest.
Land soft and go again.

exercises.name: Hurdle hop
cues: Two feet over a line of mini hurdles.
Pop off the ground fast.

exercises.name: Bounding
cues: Exaggerated running strides, long time in the air.
Drive the knee and arm.
mistakes: Over-striding and braking on each landing.

exercises.name: Split squat jump
cues: Start in a split squat.
Jump and switch legs in the air.

exercises.name: Kneeling jump
cues: Kneel tall, swing your arms.
Snap the hips and land on your feet.

exercises.name: Med ball rotational throw
cues: Side-on to a wall, ball at your back hip.
Rotate from the hips and throw hard into the wall.
mistakes: Throwing with the arms instead of the hips.

exercises.name: Step-in rotational med ball throw
cues: Step toward the wall as you load the back hip.
Fire the hips and release.

exercises.name: Med ball shot put throw
cues: Ball at your shoulder, side-on.
Drive from the back leg and push it out.

exercises.name: Med ball chest pass
cues: Ball at your chest.
Step and pass it hard into the wall.

exercises.name: Med ball slam
cues: Reach the ball overhead.
Slam it into the floor with everything.
mistakes: Rounding the back to pick it up.

exercises.name: Med ball overhead throw
cues: Ball overhead, staggered stance.
Throw it forward like a soccer throw-in.

exercises.name: Med ball scoop toss
cues: Hinge with the ball between your knees.
Drive the hips and toss it up and back.

exercises.name: Med ball side toss
cues: Partner or wall to your side.
Rotate and toss across your body.

exercises.name: Hang power clean
cues: Bar at mid-thigh, jump and shrug.
Pull yourself under and catch on the shoulders.

exercises.name: Power clean
cues: From the floor, accelerate past the knees.
Extend fully then drop under to catch.

exercises.name: Hang power snatch
cues: Wide grip, bar at mid-thigh.
Explode and punch the bar overhead.

exercises.name: Dumbbell snatch
cues: One dumbbell between your feet.
Drive with the hips and punch it overhead.

exercises.name: Kettlebell clean
cues: Hike the bell back.
Pop the hips and let the bell land softly in the rack.
mistakes: Bell flipping over and banging the wrist.

exercises.name: Jump shrug
cues: Bar at mid-thigh.
Jump and shrug hard, arms straight.

exercises.name: Landmine rotation
cues: Arms long, bar end at head height.
Pivot the feet and sweep the bar hip to hip.
mistakes: Bending the arms to move the bar.

exercises.name: Cable woodchop
cues: High handle, arms long.
Rotate down and across, turning the back foot.

exercises.name: Low-to-high cable chop
cues: Low handle, rotate up and across.
Drive from the hips.

exercises.name: Band speed rotation
cues: Band anchored at chest height.
Rotate fast and stop dead.
mistakes: Letting the band yank you back.

exercises.name: Acceleration sprint
cues: Lean forward and drive the ground back.
Push for the first five steps, then stride.
mistakes: Popping upright on the first step.

exercises.name: Flying sprint
cues: Build up over 20 m, then sprint the zone.
Tall, relaxed, fast.

exercises.name: Sled sprint
cues: Light sled; sprint with a strong forward lean.
Keep the drive phase long.
mistakes: Loading so heavy it turns into a walk.

exercises.name: Hill sprint
cues: Short, steep hill.
Drive the knees and arms; walk back down.

exercises.name: Falling start
cues: Lean forward until you have to step.
Sprint out of the fall.

exercises.name: Half-kneeling start
cues: Start on one knee.
Explode out low and fast.

exercises.name: Split-step reaction
cues: Small hop as your partner (or a call) gives a direction.
Land wide and push off toward the cue.

exercises.name: Split step to first step
cues: Split-step, then explode two to three steps to a cone.
Open the hip and push off the outside leg.

exercises.name: Drop step
cues: Open the hip and step back on a diagonal.
Sprint to the ball.

exercises.name: Crossover step
cues: Shuffle, then cross over and sprint.
Drive the trailing knee across.
mistakes: Standing up tall during the crossover.

exercises.name: Lateral shuffle
cues: Low athletic stance, feet never touch.
Push from the trailing leg.

exercises.name: Band-resisted shuffle
cues: Band around the waist, partner or anchor holding.
Shuffle against the pull.

exercises.name: Pro agility shuttle (5-10-5)
cues: Sprint 5 yards, touch, sprint 10 back, touch, sprint 5.
Drop the hips into each turn.

exercises.name: Cone shuttle
cues: Sprint between two cones and touch each line.
Plant, drop low, push back.

exercises.name: Spider drill
cues: From the center mark, sprint to each line or cone and back.
Recover to the middle every time.
mistakes: Turning your back to the court.

exercises.name: Fan drill
cues: Five cones in a fan around you.
Shuffle or sprint to each, then back to center.

exercises.name: T-drill
cues: Sprint forward, shuffle left, shuffle right, shuffle back to center, backpedal.
Stay low through every change.

exercises.name: Box drill
cues: Four cones in a square.
Sprint, shuffle, backpedal, shuffle around it.

exercises.name: Mirror drill
cues: Face a partner and copy their movements.
Stay low and react, don't guess.

exercises.name: Ball drop reaction
cues: Partner holds a ball at shoulder height and drops it.
Sprint and catch it before the second bounce.

exercises.name: Ladder in-and-out
cues: Two feet in, two feet out, move down the ladder.
Light, quick feet.
mistakes: Looking down at your feet the whole way.

exercises.name: Ladder Icky shuffle
cues: In, in, out down the ladder.
Stay on the balls of your feet.

exercises.name: Ladder lateral run
cues: Side-on, both feet in each square.
Fast and light.

exercises.name: Ladder carioca
cues: Side-on, cross over in front and behind.
Rotate the hips, not the shoulders.

exercises.name: Carioca
cues: Move sideways crossing front then behind.
Let the hips turn.

exercises.name: A-skip
cues: Skip with a high knee and dorsiflexed foot.
Strike down under your hips.

exercises.name: B-skip
cues: A-skip, then extend the leg and paw it back.
Stay tall.
mistakes: Kicking the leg out in front.

exercises.name: High knees
cues: Run in place driving knees to hip height.
Quick arms.

exercises.name: Butt kicks
cues: Run in place, heels to your glutes.
Stay light.

exercises.name: Wall drive
cues: Hands on a wall, body leaning at 45 degrees.
Drive one knee up, switch quickly.
mistakes: Hips bending so the lean is lost.

exercises.name: Deceleration drill
cues: Sprint 10 m and stop in three steps.
Sink the hips and keep the chest over the knees.
mistakes: Stopping with the feet way out in front.

exercises.name: Lateral sprint and recover
cues: From the center mark, sprint wide to a cone.
Plant on the outside leg and recover with a crossover.

exercises.name: Shadow footwork
cues: Move through forehand and backhand footwork without a ball.
Split-step before every move.

exercises.name: Air bike intervals
cues: All-out effort for the work interval.
Easy spin during the rest.
mistakes: Pacing the sprints instead of going hard.

exercises.name: Steady bike
cues: Easy pace you could hold a conversation at.
Keep a steady cadence.
mistakes: Going too hard to keep it easy.

exercises.name: Rower intervals
cues: Legs, then hips, then arms on the drive.
Hard work, easy recovery.

exercises.name: Steady row
cues: Smooth strokes at an easy effort.
Long drive, slow return.

exercises.name: Treadmill intervals
cues: Fast run for the work, walk or jog for the rest.
Step off to the rails if needed.

exercises.name: Easy run
cues: Conversational pace.
Relaxed shoulders, quick light steps.
mistakes: Turning every run into a hard one.

exercises.name: Tempo run
cues: Comfortably hard, a pace you could hold for about an hour.
Stay smooth.

exercises.name: Brisk walk
cues: Walk fast enough to breathe harder.
Arms swinging.

exercises.name: Incline walk
cues: Steep incline, steady pace.
Don't hold the rails.

exercises.name: Repeated sprints
cues: Short sprint, short rest, repeat.
Hold your speed across the set.

exercises.name: Court suicides
cues: Sprint to each line and back, getting farther each time.
Touch every line.

exercises.name: Point-play intervals
cues: Ten seconds of match-pace footwork, twenty seconds rest.
Mirror the rhythm of real points.
mistakes: Making work bouts much longer than real points.

exercises.name: Jump rope
cues: Small jumps on the balls of your feet.
Turn the rope with the wrists.

exercises.name: Double unders
cues: Jump a little higher and spin the rope twice.
Fast wrists, tight elbows.

exercises.name: Burpee
cues: Squat, kick back to a plank, return and jump.
Keep a rhythm you can hold.
mistakes: Collapsing the hips in the plank.

exercises.name: Step-back burpee
cues: Step back to a plank one leg at a time.
Step in and stand.

exercises.name: Mountain climber
cues: Plank position, drive knees to chest in turn.
Keep the hips level.

exercises.name: Jumping jacks
cues: Jump feet out as arms go up, then back in.
Stay light.

exercises.name: Kettlebell complex
cues: Swing, clean, press, squat back to back.
Don't put the bell down until the round ends.
mistakes: Form falling apart late in the round.

exercises.name: Sled push intervals
cues: Push for the work interval, rest for the rest.
Drive through the balls of your feet.
mistakes: Arms bent and doing the work.

exercises.name: Ski erg intervals
cues: Reach tall, pull down with the lats and hinge.
Hard work, easy recovery.

exercises.name: Easy swim
cues: Smooth strokes, long and relaxed.
Breathe every two or three strokes.

exercises.name: Stair climb
cues: Steady pace, whole foot on each step.
Stand tall.

exercises.name: Shuttle run
cues: Run between lines 20 m apart.
Turn on the line every time.

exercises.name: 90/90 hip switch
cues: Sit with both knees bent at 90 degrees.
Rotate the knees side to side, staying tall.
mistakes: Leaning way back on your hands.

exercises.name: World's greatest stretch
cues: Lunge forward, inside elbow to the instep.
Rotate and reach to the ceiling.

exercises.name: Couch stretch
cues: Back knee in the corner of a couch or wall, shin up.
Squeeze the glute and stay tall.

exercises.name: Half-kneeling hip flexor stretch
cues: Kneel on one knee, tuck the pelvis.
Shift forward gently.

exercises.name: Pigeon stretch
cues: Front shin across, back leg long.
Fold forward over the front leg.

exercises.name: Figure-four stretch
cues: On your back, ankle over the opposite knee.
Pull the bottom leg toward you.
mistakes: Lifting the head and straining the neck.

exercises.name: Hamstring stretch
cues: Lie on your back, band around one foot.
Lift the straight leg until you feel a stretch.

exercises.name: Adductor rock-back
cues: On hands and knees, one leg straight out to the side.
Rock your hips back toward your heel.

exercises.name: Frog stretch
cues: Knees wide, shins parallel.
Sink the hips back slowly.

exercises.name: Deep squat hold
cues: Sit into your deepest squat, heels down.
Push the knees out with your elbows.

exercises.name: Ankle rock
cues: Half kneel, front foot near a wall.
Drive the knee over the toes toward the wall.

exercises.name: Calf stretch
cues: Hands on a wall, back leg straight.
Press the back heel down.

exercises.name: Ankle circles
cues: Lift one foot and draw slow circles.
Both directions.

exercises.name: Single-leg balance
cues: Stand on one foot, soft knee.
Hold steady, then try eyes closed.

exercises.name: Single-leg balance reach
cues: Balance on one leg.
Reach the other foot forward, sideways and back.
mistakes: Knee caving on the standing leg.

exercises.name: Open book
cues: Lie on your side, knees bent, arms together.
Open the top arm across and follow it with your eyes.

exercises.name: Thread the needle
cues: On hands and knees, reach one arm under the other.
Then open it to the ceiling.
mistakes: Sitting the hips back to fake the rotation.

exercises.name: Cat-cow
cues: On hands and knees.
Round the spine up, then let it sag, slowly.

exercises.name: Thoracic extension on a foam roller
cues: Roller across your upper back, hands behind your head.
Extend back over it, ribs down.

exercises.name: Wall slide
cues: Back and forearms on a wall.
Slide the arms up without losing contact.

exercises.name: Band shoulder pass-through
cues: Wide grip on a band or stick.
Pass it overhead and behind with straight arms.
mistakes: Grip so narrow the elbows bend.

exercises.name: Sleeper stretch
cues: Lie on your side, arm at 90 degrees in front.
Gently press the forearm toward the floor.

exercises.name: Cross-body shoulder stretch
cues: Pull one arm across your chest.
Keep the shoulder down.

exercises.name: Doorway chest stretch
cues: Forearm on a doorframe at shoulder height.
Step through until you feel the chest.

exercises.name: Lat stretch
cues: Hold a post and sink the hips back.
Let the arm lengthen.

exercises.name: Wrist mobility circuit
cues: Circles, flexion and extension on all fours.
Gentle pressure, no pain.

exercises.name: Neck mobility
cues: Slow nods, turns and tilts.
Stay in a comfortable range.

exercises.name: Leg swings
cues: Hold a wall and swing one leg front to back.
Then side to side.
mistakes: Arching the back to swing higher.

exercises.name: Walking knee hug
cues: Pull one knee to your chest and rise onto the toes.
Step and switch.

exercises.name: Inchworm
cues: Fold down, walk the hands out to a plank.
Walk the feet back in.

exercises.name: Spiderman lunge
cues: Step into a lunge, hand inside the front foot.
Sink the hips, then switch.

exercises.name: Clamshell
cues: Lie on your side, knees bent.
Open the top knee without rolling back.

exercises.name: Fire hydrant
cues: On hands and knees.
Lift the knee out to the side, keep the hips level.

exercises.name: Band external rotation
cues: Elbow tucked at your side, bent to 90 degrees.
Rotate the hand out, slowly back.
mistakes: Elbow drifting away from the body.

exercises.name: Band internal rotation
cues: Elbow at your side, bent to 90.
Rotate the hand in across your belly.

exercises.name: 90/90 external rotation
cues: Elbow at shoulder height, bent to 90.
Rotate the forearm up and back slowly.

exercises.name: Side-lying external rotation
cues: Lie on your side, towel under the elbow.
Rotate the dumbbell up, lower slowly.

exercises.name: Prone Y-T-W
cues: Face down, lift the arms into Y, T, then W.
Thumbs up, shoulders down.

exercises.name: Scapular push-up
cues: Plank position, arms straight.
Let the chest sink between the shoulders, then push away.

exercises.name: Serratus wall slide
cues: Forearms on a wall with a foam roller.
Roll up while pushing into the wall.

exercises.name: Eccentric wrist extension
cues: Forearm supported, palm down.
Lift with the other hand, lower slowly with the working wrist.

exercises.name: Tyler twist
cues: Hold a flexible bar out front.
Twist and lower slowly with the affected wrist.

exercises.name: Finger extensor band
cues: Rubber band around your fingertips.
Spread the fingers open against it.

exercises.name: Foam roll quads
cues: Roller under your thighs.
Roll slowly, pause on tight spots.

exercises.name: Foam roll calves
cues: Roller under your calves.
Cross one leg over for more pressure.

exercises.name: Foam roll upper back
cues: Roller across your upper back.
Hug yourself and roll slowly.

exercises.name: 90/90 breathing
cues: On your back, feet on a wall, knees and hips at 90.
Slow breath in through the nose, long breath out.

exercises.name: Warm-up jog
cues: Easy jog to raise your temperature.
Gradually build the pace.
